additions.title: SkillsUSA Championships
additions.costNote: Entry is through a local SkillsUSA chapter in a career and technical education program; chapter and conference fees vary by school and state.
additions.deadlineNote: Registration deadlines are set by each state association; state conferences are usually in spring.
additions.description: National hands-on skill competition in trades, technology, design and service occupations. Students advance from chapter to district and state contests; state gold medalists compete June 21-25, 2027 in Atlanta.

additions.title: YoungArts National Arts Competition
additions.location: Online application; National YoungArts Week in Miami, FL
additions.costNote: An application fee applies; a fee waiver may be available. Confirm current fee and waiver process on youngarts.org.
additions.deadlineNote: The 2027 cycle closed Oct 6, 2026. The 2028 application opens in Summer 2027; deadline not yet published (recent cycles closed in early October).
additions.description: Competition for artists ages 15-18 or in grades 10-12 in visual, literary, design, dance, music, theater and film disciplines. Winners are invited to National YoungArts Week. Applicants must be U.S. citizens, permanent residents or otherwise able to receive taxable income.

additions.title: Youth Conservation Corps (U.S. Forest Service)
additions.location: National forests and public lands nationwide
additions.costNote: Paid at the higher of federal or state minimum wage.
additions.deadlineNote: No national deadline; check partner conservation corps and local Forest Service offices, which often hire in winter and spring.
additions.description: Paid 1-3 month summer conservation work on national forests and public lands. Youth must be 15 to 18, U.S. citizens or permanent residents with a Social Security number, and able to get a state work permit.

additions.title: National FFA Scholarship Program
additions.costNote: No application fee reported; FFA membership is required.
additions.deadlineNote: Applications are typically open from early November to mid-January; confirm the exact date on ffa.org.
additions.description: Scholarships for FFA members pursuing agriculture and related careers, funded by many sponsors through one application. Open to current FFA members who are graduating seniors or already in college; award amounts vary by scholarship.

additions.title: National Park Service Youth Conservation Corps (YCC)
additions.costNote: Paid summer work; pay and housing vary by park (some parks provide housing, many are day programs).
additions.deadlineNote: The 2027 park list is expected in late January or early February; each park sets its own deadline (e.g. Yellowstone expects mid-February to March 1).
additions.description: Summer work program for ages 15-18 doing conservation and maintenance projects in national parks. Applicants must be U.S. citizens or permanent residents; apply directly to each park using the DI-4014 form.

additions.title: National Flight Academy Deployment Program
additions.costNote: Fee-based nonprofit program; check the official site for current cost and funding or scholarship options.
additions.deadlineNote: Session dates and registration are listed on the official registration page; 2027 dates not confirmed.
additions.description: Immersive 6-day, 5-night program on a simulated aircraft carrier at NAS Pensacola for grades 6-12, with STEM and aviation teamwork missions.

additions.title: NIH Summer Internship Program (SIP)
additions.location: Bethesda, MD and other NIH campuses
additions.costNote: Paid stipend (amount on NIH stipends page). NIH does not provide housing; proof of health insurance required.
additions.deadlineNote: Applications close Jan 26, 2027, 12 p.m. ET; reference letters due Feb 2, 2027. Seniors must be enrolled at least half-time, and 18 by Sept 30, 2027 (17-year-old seniors near an NIH campus may qualify). U.S. citizen or permanent resident.
additions.description: Full-time, in-person summer research internship in an NIH lab between May 10 and Aug 31, 2027. Open to graduating high-school seniors who meet the age and residency rules; interns must graduate before starting.

additions.title: Regeneron International Science and Engineering Fair (ISEF)
additions.costNote: Entry is by winning a Society-affiliated local, regional or state fair; fair fees vary. Check each fair for fee waivers.
additions.deadlineNote: Fair deadlines vary; find an affiliated fair at findafair.societyforscience.org. Finals are in Los Angeles in May 2027 (exact dates not listed on page).
additions.description: The world's largest pre-college science and engineering competition. Students qualify by winning an affiliated science fair, then present research at the finals for awards and scholarships.

additions.title: Davidson Fellows Scholarship
additions.location: Online application; awards in Washington, DC
additions.deadlineNote: 2027 application is open; deadline not stated on the main page. See How to Apply or email DavidsonFellows@DavidsonGifted.org. Applicants must be 18 or younger at the deadline.
additions.description: Scholarships of $100,000, $50,000 and $25,000 for young people 18 or younger who completed a significant piece of work in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Literature, Music, Philosophy or Outside the Box.

targetSuggestions.note: National arts competition for ages 15-18; 2028 cycle opens summer 2027.

targetSuggestions.org: U.S. Forest Service Youth Conservation Corps
targetSuggestions.note: Paid summer conservation jobs for ages 15-18.
Aviation scholarships; the 2027 cycle closed Sept 1, 2026, and the next opens mid-2027. Membership required.
Aviation immersion program for grades 6-12 with registration and funding info.
Summer Internship Program; applications close late January each year.
Davidson Fellows; STEM categories, ages 18 and under.
